title: Pi Harness Extension Health Audit
summary: Audit of extension entry points, loading model, crash containment, and session finalization boundary.

sections.content: Audit scope: local harness-controlled extension loading, crash containment, and session finalization. Evidence came from `extensions/vscodium-rig-relay/src/extension.ts`, `rig_relay/cli/ide_sidecar.py`, `rig_relay/acp/_session_lifecycle.py`, `rig_relay/evidence/session_lifecycle_tool.py`, and coordination/session tooling.

rows: VS Code extension `activate()` spawns the sidecar and registers a webview; ACP and desktop entrypoints bootstrap agent loops and config.
Current extension host loads one local extension and then spawns the sidecar eagerly; no discovery registry or lazy activation gate was found in repo-controlled code.
Existing code logs sidecar exit/spawn errors, but extension failures can still terminate the sidecar path and leave no explicit quarantine state.
No extension crash history or quarantine manifest was found.
Session lifecycle finalizer exists and is content-light; it is independent of the extension host path.
Coordination ownership exists in path/task/lease tools and docs; no visible file-marker protocol existed before this slice.
